title: Add five reviewed mineral and photographic-fixer records
counts_status: Final artifact enumeration reconciled; actual exact-byte positive scientific coverage verified.
selection: Five additions distinguish four mineral species and a liquid secondary resource. The records cover transient fungal-associated wheatleyite, abiotic-control libethenite, provisional bacterial otavite, thermal cerianite from a fungal-conditioned precursor and a hybrid recovery process for used photographic fixer.
limitations: The records preserve phase-assignment uncertainty, control limits, source inconsistencies and laboratory scope. Shared studies are not independent replications; criticality is not inherited from constituent elements.
issue_summary: Independent review found README wording that overstated diffraction nondetection as absence. Issue #269 tracks the narrow correction and independent successor disposition; the scientific record already retained the limit. Source follow-ups [#267](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/267) and [#268](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CMMMech/issues/268), plus existing #120 and #265, remain open.
